newsitem.title: USA: Brooks plans not hurt by FCC rules stay.
newsitem.headline: Brooks plans not hurt by FCC rules stay.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc, a provider of local telecommunications services, said Friday the company's plans have not been affected by a partial stay of the Federal Communications Commission Interconnection Order that mandates competition at the local level.
"We already have interconnection agreements covering 25 of the 30 markets that the company serves and they remain in full force," said chief executive officer James Allen in a statement.

On Thursday, Brooks Fiber said it attained "our long held goal of reaching 30 markets by the end of 1996 with the announcement of a network in Stamford, Conn. We now look toward our longer term goal of 50 cities by 1998," Allen said.
